thesis: The speaker recounts his career beginning at age 15 when he traded P. Lard cigarettes instead of AT&T, making $26 on a single trade and deciding then that he wanted to be in the stock market. He describes his early education in geography and history while studying the market daily, followed by a period teaching school and attending law school before becoming a retail broker.
